description: Executable Candidate adaptation of MiaAI-Lab's DGX Spark lane for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B NVFP4 with NVIDIA's DSpark draft on SGLang (cookbook DSpark operating point: mem-fraction 0.78, block size 3, 1M context). Upstream reports ~4.9M-token pool and 48 concurrent requests on a Spark; those are upstream claims, not measured here. The RTX 5090 / 6000 PRO lanes are not modelled.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B SGLang DSpark single Spark (Mia)
